guards.what: Escape is not death - the sim keeps the two apart
guards.rationale: PROMPT.md class 21 / SHARED-FINDINGS section 7's 'death is not removal' has a mirror here: an ESCAPE is removal without death. CreatureCmd.escape (cmds.py:221-235) sets `escaped`, not `hp = 0`; creatures.py distinguishes is_dead from is_gone; and the sim re-checks the win condition after the escape (cmds.py:231-235), mirroring the game's CheckWinCondition. So the Fat Gremlin leaves with its stolen gold intact rather than dying and paying it out, which is the whole point of the encounter (GremlinMercNormal.CalculateGoldProportion, GremlinMercNormal.cs:59-68). The gold payout itself belongs to the encounter/rewards tier, not to this record.
